quotes.text: This was such a great outing. My husband and I took our 9 year old grandson for a fun adventure. The communication was great. Check-in was easy. Instructions were efficient, easy to follow, and we were out on the water right away. Our grandson loved it. We took snacks and it was a perfect outing for the afternoon. We will definitely go again.

We had the best time on the cycle boat for the 4th of July! The captain was fun, welcoming, and made the whole experience smooth and stress-free. Great energy, music, sunshine, and good vibes all around. It was such a memorable way to celebrate the holiday with friends on the water. Highly recommend. Can’t wait to do it again!

Amazing experience!! We enjoyed a perfect sunset cruise around the Sausalito bay with friends. A must-do activity if you're in the Bay Area! The team was informative, friendly, and got us boarded quickly. The boat was clean, safe, and had a great speaker system. What a fun way to enjoy the water. We will absolutely be back.

Book this now, you will love it!! Such a great experience, wonderful, helpful, friendly staff. The perfect experience from start to finish. Boats are super fun, well equipped, and easy to drive. Our party of 10 had the best time. Can’t wait to return!

This was the best birthday surprise for my boyfriend! We did a 3 hour ride and it was so much! We brought our own drinks and snacks although I would recommend to bring blankets because it can get chilly. I will definitely be booking this again!
